---
name: Candidate report (for review before external submission)
about: Share a possible discovery so others can check it first
labels: candidate
---

> Please read docs/about/how-to-report-a-discovery.md first. Use the word "candidate". If you are under 18, have a parent, guardian or teacher post this.

**What** (one sentence)

**Related disclosure** (D01–D15)

**Data** (archive, IDs, dates, versions)

**Method** (fdastro version, settings, random seeds)

**Result** (numbers with uncertainties)

**Checks already done** (artifacts, known objects, trials correction, alternative methods)

**What observation would confirm or refute it?**
